entries.notes: Optional until the Capell screenshot runner has a route-backed public fixture that renders Capell frontend BodyEnd hooks with Insights enabled in a fresh browser context with no capell_insights_consent localStorage entry and no capell_insights_visit cookie. The capture must show the packaged consent banner, not a plain demo page.
